newsitem.title: UK: Spain awards mandate for euro Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Spain awards mandate for euro Eurobond.

text.p: Spain has awarded the mandate for its planned jumbo euro Eurobond to four banks, Banco Central Hispano, Paribas, Santander and SBC Warburg, Paribas said on Tuesday.
Spain has been planning the deal for some while. It will be redenominated into euros after EMU, after which it will be fungible with a a 6.00 percent Bono due January 31, 2008.
Spain has been touting an issue size of 1.0 billion Ecu but market sources said 1.25 billion Ecu was likely, at a spread of 18-20 basis points over a French Ecu OAT.

At 1000 GMT, Spain's benchmark 10-year peseta bond, the 7.35 percent Bono due March 2007, was trading at a yield around 6.25 percent, just under 80 b.p. over France's 5.50 percent franc OAT due April 2007.
